title: Benn Jordan on Flock, privacy, and the new surveillance backlash
description: Today, I’m talking with Benn Jordan, musician, YouTuber, researcher, and investigative journalist. You might know Benn from those first two titles — he’s got a prolific discography of experimental music dating back decades.
